resources.practice_worker: 4 CPU cores and 16 GiB without a GPU; separate workers outside the research budget, one practice job at a time
resources.leases: 0 or 1 L40S, 1-32 CPU cores, 2-64 GiB, researcher commands, shared /scratch Volume
resources.concurrency: seconds mode (default): one training run or lease at a time; usd mode: 4 active jobs, at most 2 with a GPU and 64 CPU cores in total. Practice is one job at a time in either mode
resources.charging: seconds mode: seconds of the training worker = worker seconds x harness.budget.seconds_weight(shape, training worker); usd mode: US dollars = worker seconds x cost(shape), at the frozen Modal sandbox list prices in contract.py PRICE

budget.modes: seconds or usd, chosen per session (harness --budget-mode, --research-seconds or --research-usd); the ledger records the mode and a resumed session keeps it
budget.historical_ledgers: preserved; sessions of the earlier contract (v1, seconds of one worker with its own ledger files) cannot be continued or graded under this contract

usd_mode.concurrency: parallel: up to 4 jobs, 2 GPUs, 64 CPU cores

starter.early_end: a run the researcher stops, or one cut off at its time limit, is packaged from the last complete policy it wrote and is complete (stopped_early, cut_short); a run that wrote none fails

evaluation.calibration_gate: three full-budget seeds and independent stronger panel not yet qualified
evaluation.smoke_opponents: independently initialized minimal random policy; weak diagnostic panel
evaluation.isolation: UID-isolated inference processes with visible features/masks only; trusted Rust state remains root-only
evaluation.panel_inventory: host-private-panel/inventory.json in prepared host release; never mounted in public agent image

commands.smoke: .venv-polytopia-ar/bin/python -m harness run polytopia network --release RELEASE --out NEW_SESSION --smoke --model MODEL --execute
commands.session: .venv-polytopia-ar/bin/python -m harness run polytopia recipe --release RELEASE --out NEW_SESSION --model MODEL --execute
